test_title: PYST 6: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 27 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Hostil.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling should be 'Hostile.'
 
• Hostile means having very strong feelings against somebody/something.

 • *Example*- *The experience has made him generally **hostile** towards women.*

Therefore, the correct answer is option 2 which is incorrectly spelled.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Huddle - to gather or crowd together in a close mass

 
 
• For e.g.- People were **huddling **(together) in doorways to get out of the rain
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__** The rest of the options are correctly spelled.
